config.penalty_scaling: fractions of the design-Gram largest eigenvalue
config.normaliser: mean per-output standard deviation of the TRAIN rows of the fold
config.metric_slicing: the graph metrics are 55x55 and act on the load-MAGNITUDE block, so P and Q share one metric; every graph-kernel baseline uses this same construction
config.baseline_contamination: no baseline touches S or any sensitivity Jacobian; b1 is the RBF on raw injections, b2/b3 are hop and admittance graph metrics from line data, b4 is ridge on injections, b5 is LinDistFlow plus ridge calibration

R1_small_n_crossing_at_10.interpretation: at n=10 the 47-parameter physics calibration nearly interpolates the training rows, so the residual GP has almost nothing left to fit and this arm is approximately the physics baseline by construction

R1_small_n_crossing_at_20.interpretation: at n=10 the 47-parameter physics calibration nearly interpolates the training rows, so the residual GP has almost nothing left to fit and this arm is approximately the physics baseline by construction

R3_coverage_repair.rule: usable if, at every n from 10 to 160, |c68-0.68|<=0.05 and |c95-0.95|<=0.05

S3_no_candidate_beats_D_by_15pct.note: the other four screened artifacts run in parallel and reading them is forbidden, so this is not evaluable inside this artifact

screen_metric_at_80_definition: mean paired margin of the physics-plus-residual GP (tempered intervals, point prediction identical to the marginal-likelihood arm) over the best of the five named baselines in the same fold, at n=80 on the 2.0x regime, averaged over 24 folds

operator_vs_archived.note: a global scalar is absorbed by the train-only feature scaler; the scale-free check is the normalised deviation, which must be below 1e-8

laplacian_symmetry.eigensolver_used: scipy.linalg.eig on L and eigh on 0.5*(L+L^H); never eigh/eigsh on L

hop_distance_diagnostic.why_not_used_as_a_metric: a distance matrix is not a kernel: it has negative eigenvalues, so clipping them (the earlier construction) leaves an object that is worse than the mean predictor

n_equals_10_interpolation.interpretation: the physics calibration has 47 parameters against 10 training rows at n=10, so it nearly interpolates and a small margin there is not new mechanism
